_comment: FunSync's scheduled jobs, run on this Mac by job-runner (crates/job-runner), which the desktop app starts. schedule: cron (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week) in the Mac's local time. catchUp: how late a run missed while the app was closed may still start. timeout: the run is stopped after this. steps run one after the other from the repo root; the job's exit code is the first that isn't 0 or 2, else 2 when a step left work, else 0. paused: not scheduled until `npm run jobs -- resume <job>`. eroscripts-scout is paused here because the Orca automation "EroScripts scout (daily)" fires it (`npm run jobs -- run eroscripts-scout`, 00:05); its schedule stays for reference.
